reviews.title: Broken. Flood of worthless notifications.
reviews.text:
Delays are not showing. My last four flights have not shown correct delay data. Isn’t that the whole point of the app? 

Let me turn off gate change notifications until an hour before the flight. Gosh I get nonstop united gate change notifications and it floods my app. No way to only turn those off. Fix it. The gate notifications are INSANE! Nonstop worthless 24 hours out. 

It says delayed, it’s red! Oh no! Wait, it’s getting there 2 minutes “late”…. Try yellow. Don’t freak me out that I’m gonna be late if it’s two minutes. Need a way to turn off nonstop gate change alerts 24+ hours out. Allow us to tailor specific notifications.

The zoom in and zoom out animations are so unsafe for people who get motion sickness. This is not accessibility compliant. Give an option to limit motion.

Missing delays a lot recently.

reviews.title: Not quite…but almost!
reviews.text:
Great App overall, but not showing the departure gate for a busy airport in Central America like San Jose - Costa Rica. It was disappointing.  All other apps did work with this feature. Flighty charge RIDICULOUSLY (over $50 bucks) for something Siri already gives you free and most airlines are already communicating in real time the status of flights. So paying over $50 a year for this subscription seems a waste. Subscription should be lower for it to make sense and have all your flights summarized in the same place. 

Another improvement I suggest is having a REAL alert in both the iPhone and Apple Watch when a flight is cancelled or delayed. I only saw a red icon when I looked at my iPhone, but it did not vibrate or alert consistently until acknowledged.  Thank God my travel agency did send me text messages warning about the cancellation.

reviews.title: Nearly lost fight
reviews.text:
I read the great reviews and decided to use Flighty on my return flight from Turkey. Unfortunately, the flight tracking was completely unreliable and nearly caused me to miss my flight.

While I was sitting in the airport lounge, Flighty told me that my flight was delayed by 38 minutes. I relied on that information and stayed in the lounge, only to discover that the flight was actually on time. I ended up rushing to the gate and was extremely lucky not to miss it.

The biggest issue is that Flighty doesn’t appear to provide genuine GPS tracking. When it loses its internet connection, the aircraft position seems to be simulated or extrapolated rather than showing its actual location. At one point, while we were already approaching the airport, the app was showing the aircraft flying over the Red Sea!

For an app whose main selling point is accurate flight tracking, this is a serious problem. I wouldn’t rely on Flighty for real-time flight status or tracking, particularly when deciding whether you need to head to the gate.

reviews.title: Be careful of purchase options
reviews.text: I used this last year with a short period subscription when I was travelling.  It was excellent.  I went back to activate a short subscription for my trips this month and the payment options were unclear and led me to an annual subscription which is no use to me.  I have deleted the app and asked Apple to ensure no charge but it would be good practice to present the range of purchase options first  rather than taking me to the annual one.  I won’t be using this again until I can safely just purchase a short term subscription.  Fingers crossed I don’t get charged for the 3 minutes it was on my phone.

reviews.title: Not intuitive and need to be able to add a friend without an invitation
reviews.text: I just joined Flighty as a pro to “upgrade” from FlightView but I am find it awkward to figure out how to do basic things.  For example, I my 83 year old mother is coming to visit me and I have to out her flight information is as my own?  I’m not going to invite her to join Flighty since it is way too complicated an app for an older person but I do need to track her flight.  Why can’t I just add a friend and put her flight information into my app with her name on it? Also, why does the app tell me my flight is in 13 days in big font?  Just out the friggin date on that left side instead.  I’m not counting down the days to my next business trip.  There are may examples of how the app makes something that should be simpler too complicated.  I’m happy to have the extra info about on time percentage, precious flight, etc, but by trying to be too clever this app doesn’t do the basics in a clear and simple way.  Update a month later:  Still not happy.  My son’s flight canceled tonight and flighty is still notifying me that he’s landing in an hour.  Not accurate, not simple, missing important features.  Disappointed that I paid for a full family year long subscription.

reviews.title: Data connection issues
reviews.text: I installed the app based on its strong reviews and recommendations, but my experience with the integration features has been consistently unsuccessful.  First, I attempted to connect my TripIt account following the documented best-practice steps. Each attempt resulted in an “invalid form submission” error when using Brave, Chrome, and Safari. While this may originate from the Concur API rather than your application directly, the integration is presented as a supported feature. From a user perspective, the responsibility for ensuring a functional connection lies with the app implementing the API. As it stands, the TripIt connection is unusable.  As a fallback, I tried syncing via my calendar. Four out of five flight legs that appear in my calendar and are correctly imported into the app. However, one leg is not recognized. The missing leg is formatted identically to the others, auto-generated, and contains no structural differences. I then attempted to sync using the TripIt subscribed calendar, but the same leg remained unrecognized.  At present, three supported connection methods yield incomplete or failed results. I reinstalled the app, logged out and back in, deactivated and reactivated calendar access, and repeated the setup multiple times. The issue persists.  The UI and feature set are well designed, but without reliable and secure data integration, the application cannot be used as intended.
